description: This file implements replay functionality for the Battle for Wesnoth game, including replay management, command recording, and replay execution logic.

classes.name: verification_manager
classes.description: Manages verification of unit structures between machines during replay.

classes.name: replay
classes.description: Handles recording, saving, and playback of game replays, including command management and undo functionality.

classes.name: replay_network_sender
classes.description: Handles sending replay data over the network during multiplayer games.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that the unit structure matches the expected configuration.

methods.name: create_verification
methods.description: Creates a configuration snapshot of the current unit map for verification.

methods.name: verify_units
methods.description: Performs verification of units against a stored reference.

methods.name: make_verify_units
methods.description: Generates a verification configuration for current units.

methods.name: replay
methods.description: Default constructor for replay class.

methods.name: replay
methods.description: Constructor initializing replay with a given configuration.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the current replay configuration.

methods.name: set_save_info
methods.description: Stores game state information for saving.

methods.name: get_save_info
methods.description: Retrieves stored game state information.

methods.name: set_skip
methods.description: Sets the number of turns to skip in replay.

methods.name: next_skip
methods.description: Decrements the skip counter.

methods.name: skipping
methods.description: Checks if replay is currently skipping turns.

methods.name: save_game
methods.description: Saves the current game state and replay data with a label.

methods.name: add_start
methods.description: Adds a start command to the replay.

methods.name: add_recruit
methods.description: Records a recruit command at a location.

methods.name: add_recall
methods.description: Records a recall command at a location.

methods.name: add_disband
methods.description: Records a disband command.

methods.name: add_movement
methods.description: Records a move command between locations.

methods.name: add_attack
methods.description: Records an attack command with weapon info.

methods.name: add_pos
methods.description: Records a positional command (move/attack).

methods.name: add_value
methods.description: Records a command with an integer value.

methods.name: choose_option
methods.description: Records a choice command.

methods.name: add_label
methods.description: Records a label command at a location.

methods.name: add_rename
methods.description: Records a rename command at a location.

methods.name: end_turn
methods.description: Records an end turn command.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Records a speak/chat command.

methods.name: build_chat_log
methods.description: Builds a chat log string for a team.

methods.name: get_data_range
methods.description: Retrieves a range of commands for processing.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last command.

methods.name: commands
methods.description: Returns list of all commands.

methods.name: ncommands
methods.description: Returns the number of commands.

methods.name: mark_current
methods.description: Marks the current command.

methods.name: add_command
methods.description: Adds a new command to the replay.

methods.name: start_replay
methods.description: Resets replay to start.

methods.name: get_next_action
methods.description: Retrieves the next command for replay.

methods.name: pre_replay
methods.description: Prepares replay by skipping start commands.

methods.name: at_end
methods.description: Checks if replay has reached the end.

methods.name: set_to_end
methods.description: Sets replay position to end.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the replay data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if replay has no commands.

methods.name: add_config
methods.description: Adds commands from a config to the replay.

methods.name: get_replay_source
methods.description: Returns the current replay source object.

methods.name: do_replay
methods.description: Executes the replay, processing commands and updating game state.

methods.name: sync_non_undoable
methods.description: Sends non-undo commands over the network.

methods.name: commit_and_sync
methods.description: Sends all commands over the network and updates state.
